fields.Name: T143 - MCP Tools Card/List View Toggle
fields.Description: Tests the ToolsViewMode 'card' vs 'list' rendering branches (two different templates for the same tool data) driven by mj-view-toggle — a distinct dual-layout code path.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Tools tab. Locate the view-mode toggle in the header (Card View and List View options). Switch between Card View and List View and confirm the tools presentation responds: card view shows tool cards, list view shows a table with columns (Tool, Description, Params, Status, Last Seen, Actions). If no tools are configured, a 'No tools discovered yet' empty state is a valid outcome and the toggle should still be present and switchable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Card/List view toggle is visible in the Tools tab header
Switching the toggle changes the tools layout (card grid vs. table) OR a valid 'No tools discovered yet' empty state is shown consistently
The active toggle option visibly reflects the current selection
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
